title: Affine scalar-extension chart transport of module cohomology
statement: Let f:X -> S and g:S prime -> S be arbitrary scheme morphisms, F a module, I and J resolutions of F and G=tensorPullback(g prime)F, p a natural number, V,W affine opens, W<=g inverse V, and D the open choices. Let the supplied Gamma(S,V)-algebra on Gamma(S prime,W) have algebraMap equal to g.appLE. Put h:f inverse V -> Spec Gamma(S,V), N=pullback F to f inverse V, T=baseChangedScheme(h), A=baseChangedModule(h,N), L=f prime inverse W, U=g prime inverse(f inverse V), and M=G restricted to L. There is an additive equivalence t from derived module sections of A on T to those of M on L. It intertwines scalar endomorphisms from the two structure maps to Spec Gamma(S prime,W). For any source module-cohomology class x, t of the baseChangeUnit h-map after the restriction/pullback coefficient comparison equals cohomologyOpenRestriction(G,U,L) of the D.psi h-map applied to x. No higher-image sheaf, Leray edge, qcqs, quasi-coherence or Ext comparison is involved.

source.place: First paragraph of Lemma 30.5.2: affine-local dictionary only, without its flatness conclusion; functoriality of h-maps in Remark 20.14.2 (01FB), pullback adjunction in 0096 (Lemma 6.26.2) and composition in 0097 (Lemma 6.26.3). Sources read on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Use the fibre-product universal property and affine chart isomorphisms to identify T with L. The equality of algebraMap with g.appLE ensures the two affine-base maps agree. Construct inverses by projection and check their composites by pullback.hom_ext.

Identify A with G restricted to L using pullback composition and the unique left-adjoint comparison between tensor pullback and ordinary pullback. The restriction/pullback iso completes the coefficient comparison. Apply cohomology h-maps along the scheme isomorphism and its inverse; their compositions are identities.

The two projections to Spec Gamma(W) agree, so naturality for multiplication gives the scalar equation. Transpose the coefficient unit equation; composite-adjunction unit identities reduce it to D.unit_square restricted to L. Apply cohomology functoriality to obtain the displayed unit equation.
The argument uses only isomorphisms, units and their naturalities and covers empty opens, zero coefficients and p=0.

theorem exists_flatBaseChange_chart_cohomology_transport
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
    [Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W)]
    (hAlgebra : algebraMap Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) = (g.appLE V W eVW).hom) :
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let T := baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h
    let A := baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N
    let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology T.toRingedSpace p
    let G := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F
    let U := (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let L := (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let e : L ≤ U := by
      change (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      rw [flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V]
      exact (pullback.fst g f).preimage_mono eVW
    let M := (restrictFunctor L.ι).obj G
    let C' := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology L.toScheme.toRingedSpace p
    let k := (pullback.fst g f).resLE W L le_rfl ≫ W.toSpecΓ
    ∃ t : C.obj A ≃+ C'.obj M,
      (∀ (a : Γ(S', W)) (y : C.obj A),
        t ((C.map (A.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S', W)).inv ≫
          (baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h).appTop).hom a))).hom y) =
        ((C'.map (M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S', W)).inv ≫ k.appTop).hom a))).hom
          (t y))) ∧
      (∀ x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F),
        t (moduleCohomologyFMap (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
          (baseChangeUnit (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p
          (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).map
            ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).app F).hom).hom x)) =
        cohomologyOpenRestriction G U L e p
          (moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) U le_rfl)
            D.psi p x))
